incidence_unit: valid physical six-minute point-count keyed by visits.survey_id; repeated counts are protocol samples, not independent places
annual_audit_unit: point x year opportunity; one or two valid bouts retained in n_valid_bouts
observer_support: site/species aggregate counts only; raw measuredBy remains only in producer-local evidence
cross_job_evidence: schema-v2 exact two-table scientific projection; source brd_perpoint has no endDate; public visits.endDate is retained as typed NA; observer identity, personnel, remarks, and source UIDs excluded
species_community_unit: safe normalized genus + species binomial; parent species and subspecies collapse; ambiguous nomenclature fails closed
source_taxonomy_provenance: reportedTaxonID, reportedScientificName, reportedVernacularName, and reportedTaxonRank preserve exact source values
breeding_detection_rule: enters_incidence = matched valid visit AND pointCountMinute in 1:6 AND safely canonicalized taxonRank in species/subspecies AND known detectionMethod AND not flyover; clusterSize is not required
detection_index_rule: enters_index = enters_incidence AND cluster_size_state in recorded or blank_read_as_one (clusterSize then holds a positive finite integer count); a site, year, species, grid, or window with any enters_incidence detection outside enters_index reports birds per count as NA and states the number of detections without a usable count
cluster_size_rule: clusterSizeRaw keeps the source token and clusterSize holds the count used. A blank clusterSize on a record that names a bird (non-blank reported taxon) is read as one bird when its site-year is listed and shows the recording signature: blank on at least half of that site-year's bird records, and 1 on fewer than half of its recorded sizes. NEON.DOC.014041 Rev L, SOP B, sets the cluster size of a non-clustered bird to 1, and these crews wrote a size only for groups. This reads a documented recording convention. It is not a statistical imputation, and NEON has not corrected these records. Listed for RELEASE-2026: PUUM 2018, PUUM 2021, PUUM 2024. A blank line with no taxon is not a detection. A blank bird record in an unlisted site-year leaves birds per count NA with its stated count and is reported for review. A present value that is not a positive integer (0, negative, fractional, text) is invalid and is never read as one. Validation fails if a listed site-year still has blanks but no longer shows the signature.

cross_site_rule.rarefaction_support: minimum T_counts across the exact 47-site roster

climate_context_rule.realized_months: exact distinct calendar months containing valid counts in the analysis window
climate_context_rule.aggregation: equal-weight arithmetic mean across realized calendar-month climatologies
climate_context_rule.completeness: breeding_temp_c requires every realized count month to have a coverage-qualified climatology
climate_context_rule.missing_policy: retain the 47-site row; set breeding_temp_c to NA and omit only from the temperature gradient when incomplete; no imputation
